scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @school/shared && npm run build --workspace @school/types && npm run build --workspace @school/validation && npm run build --workspace @school/database && npm run build --workspace @school/api && npm run build --workspace @school/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @school/api" "npm run dev --workspace @school/web"
